matches.rationale: Finding 2 directly identifies the logits fusion equation in Section 4.2, pointing out that the claimed "positive weights that sum to 1" is mathematically unsupported because lambda_v^t and lambda_c^t are unnormalized sums that don't necessarily sum to one. This detects the same inconsistency as GT1: the fusion formula contradicts the described balancing principle.

Finding 1 identifies that attention reallocation formulas (Eq. 6-7) treat A inconsistently—as both pre-softmax scores and normalized weights—without proper normalization, which can lead to negative or invalid weights. This detects the logical inconsistency in GT2 about attention reallocation lacking proper constraints, though the finding focuses on normalization rather than causal masking specifically.
